SELECT 
  ts_doy as doy,
  ts_hour as hour,
  ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 140 AND ts_doy <= 152
ORDER BY ts_t DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT
  fish_date_doy as doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as boat_count,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / SUM(anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  CAST(SUM(yt) as INT) as total_yt
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 140 AND fish_date_doy <= 152
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC

SELECT 
  avail_doy as doy,
  avail_hour as hour,
  index_id,
  ROUND(value, 2) as value
FROM climate
WHERE index_id = 'oni'
ORDER BY avail_t DESC
LIMIT 5
